clues.text: Told to ask the LORD for a sign, King Ahaz refused, so a son with this name was promised instead.
Isaiah told the house of David that a virgin would conceive and give birth to a son called this.
Isaiah said this child would be eating curds and honey by the time He could reject evil and choose good.
Isaiah said that before this boy could tell good from evil, the land of the two kings Ahaz dreaded would be laid waste.
Isaiah pictured Assyria as Euphrates floodwaters reaching Judah's neck and covering the whole land of this one.
In Matthew's account of Jesus' birth, this name is explained as meaning 'God with us.'
After an angel spoke to Joseph in a dream, Matthew said a prophet's words about this name were fulfilled.
